dialogue.content: （おはようございます。本日もよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: (Good morning. I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.content: おはようございます。こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. You as well.

dialogue.content: （始めさせていただいてよろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (Is it alright if we begin?)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine!

dialogue.content: おはようございます。相談員です。ご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別、ご相談内容をお知らせください。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming to talk with me today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 14歳、女性いじめられています
dialogue.English: I'm 14, female, and I'm being bullied.

dialogue.content: つらいですよね…どんな事が起きているのか、聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: That must be really tough... Could you tell me what's been happening?

dialogue.content: 私に聞こえるように悪口を言ってきます
dialogue.English: They say mean things about me loud enough for me to hear.

dialogue.content: そんな…傷つきますよね…
dialogue.English: Oh, no... That must be very hurtful...

dialogue.content: 辛いです、学校に行きたくないけど親には話せないので
dialogue.English: It's painful. I don't want to go to school, but I can't talk to my parents about it.

dialogue.content: どんなこと言われたりするのかしら？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do they say to you?

dialogue.content: 空気悪い早く出ていけとかです
dialogue.English: Things like, "You're ruining the mood," and "Hurry up and get out."

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですね…ひとりで我慢しているんですね…しんどいですよね
dialogue.English: I see... You've been enduring this all by yourself... That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: え…それはひどい…
dialogue.English: Oh... That's terrible...

dialogue.content: 死ね、消えろと落書きされているのも見ました
dialogue.English: I also saw graffiti that said "Die" and "Disappear."

dialogue.content: そんな…
dialogue.English: That's awful...

dialogue.content: 生きているのが辛いです
dialogue.English: It's painful to be alive.

dialogue.content: 苦しいですよね…先ほど、親さんには話せないと言っておられましたが、誰かほかに周囲の人で、そのことを知っている人はいるのですか？
dialogue.English: That must be agonizing... You mentioned earlier that you can't talk to your parents, but is there anyone else around you who knows about this?

dialogue.content: 一緒にいてくれる友達が1人います
dialogue.English: I have one friend who stays with me.

dialogue.content: はい、その子には相談したりしているのかしら…
dialogue.English: I see. Have you been able to talk to her about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その子は、相談したとき、どんな反応でしたか？
dialogue.English: When you talked to her, how did she react?

dialogue.content: ひどいよね、辛いよね、と言ってくれます
dialogue.English: She says things like, "That's awful," and "That must be so hard."

dialogue.content: はい、学校の先生には相談したことありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever spoken to a teacher at school?

dialogue.content: 一度相談したのですが、悲劇のヒロインにでもなったつもりかと言われたのでもう相談する気になれません
dialogue.English: I did once, but they asked if I was "trying to be some kind of tragic heroine," so I don't feel like I can talk to them anymore.

dialogue.content: そんな…ショックでしたよね…
dialogue.English: Oh, no... That must have been a shock...

dialogue.content: 信用できません
dialogue.English: I can't trust them.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなるのも無理はないですよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, it's completely understandable that you'd feel that way...

dialogue.content: はい先生に言っても何も解決してくれないです
dialogue.English: Yes. Even if I tell a teacher, they won't do anything to solve it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…しんどいですよね…いじめはどれくらい続いているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... That's so tough... How long has the bullying been going on?

dialogue.content: 1ヶ月くらいですはじめてじゃなくて2回目のいじめです
dialogue.English: About a month. This isn't the first time; it's the second time I've been bullied.

dialogue.content: これがいつか終わってもまたいじめられるんじゃないかと思うとしんどいです
dialogue.English: It's hard to think that even if this ends someday, I'll just get bullied again.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…以前にもそういうことがあったんですね…苦しいよね…
dialogue.English: I see... So this has happened before... That's so painful...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 前のときは誰かに相談したりしたのかしら？
dialogue.English: The last time it happened, did you talk to anyone about it?

dialogue.content: 前の時も今一緒にいてくれる友達に相談してました
dialogue.English: Last time, I also talked to the same friend who is with me now.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、周囲の大人には相談しましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Did you talk to any adults around you?

dialogue.content: 担任に言った時にさっきの言葉を言われたので大人には相談したくないです
dialogue.English: When I told my homeroom teacher, they said what I told you before, so I don't want to talk to adults about it.

dialogue.content: そうか、その時に担任に相談したんですね、教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's when you spoke to your homeroom teacher. Thank you for telling me that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親さんも先生と同じようなこと言うのかしら？
dialogue.English: Do you think your parents would say something similar to what your teacher said?

dialogue.content: 親は言わないと思いますでも心配かけたくないので言いたくないです
dialogue.English: I don’t think my parents would say that, but I don’t want to worry them, so I don’t want to tell them.

dialogue.content: そうか…どうしてそう思うのか、聞かせてくれますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Could you tell me why you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 親が私の事で悩む姿を見たくないし、
dialogue.English: I don't want to see my parents worrying because of me, and...

dialogue.content: 親に辛かったね、と言われてしまうと私自身がダメになってしまいそうで
dialogue.English: ...and if my parents tell me, "That must have been so hard," I feel like I might just fall apart.

dialogue.content: そうか…親を悲しませたくないのかな…
dialogue.English: I see... I wonder if you don't want to make your parents sad...

dialogue.content: そうか…そうやって自分で必死に耐えているんですね…
dialogue.English: I see... So that's how you've been desperately enduring this on your own...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家は安心出来る場所、いつもどおりの場所がいいんです
dialogue.English: I want home to be a safe place, a place that's always the same as usual.

dialogue.content: それは苦しくて、しんどいですよね…
dialogue.English: That must be so painful and difficult...

dialogue.content: そうか、親さんを悲しませたら、安心できる場所ではなくなってしまうんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So if you make your parents sad, you feel that home will no longer be a safe place.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だから、それを守ろうとして、どんなにつらくても、必死に耐えているんですね…
dialogue.English: That's why, to protect that, you're desperately enduring, no matter how painful it is...

dialogue.content: ですが、あなたのことが心配です。
dialogue.English: But I'm worried about you.

dialogue.content: はい、でも辛いです
dialogue.English: I know, but it's so hard.

dialogue.content: はい、我慢の限界ですよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, you must be at your breaking point...

dialogue.content: 人に暴言を吐いたり、書いたりすることは、人の尊厳を傷つけるあってはならないことです。
dialogue.English: Saying or writing abusive things to people is something that should never happen. It damages a person's dignity.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、でもなんでいじめはなくならないんですか？
dialogue.English: That’s true... But why doesn’t bullying ever go away?

dialogue.content: はい、悲しいですよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, it's sad, isn't it...

dialogue.content: 悲しい、辛い、解決策がわからない
dialogue.English: It's sad, it's painful, and I don't know how to solve it.

dialogue.content: 解決策としては、まずはひとりで抱え込まない周囲の大人に助けを求めるこれか、ベターなのではないかと、私は考えています。
dialogue.English: As for a solution, I believe a better approach would be to start by not shouldering this alone and asking for help from the adults around you.

dialogue.content: でも学校は頼りにならない、親には心配かけたくないです
dialogue.English: But I can't rely on the school, and I don't want to worry my parents.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよねどうしても無理なときは、この窓口に話しにきてくれるだけでもいいのです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. When it feels absolutely impossible, just coming here to talk is enough.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: いじめは人の尊厳を傷つけます。あなたがわるいのではない。ひとりで耐えなくてもいいのです。
dialogue.English: Bullying damages a person's dignity. It's not your fault. You don't have to endure it alone.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: だから、またこうして話に来てほしいです。
dialogue.English: That's why I hope you'll come and talk like this again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、辛くなったらまた話を聞いてください
dialogue.English: Thank you. If it gets too hard, please listen to me again.

dialogue.content: はい、今日はお話ししてみてどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: Of course. How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: ちょっとスッキリしました。解決策はわからないけど、私の話を聞いてくれる人がいることがわかったので安心できました
dialogue.English: I feel a little better. I still don't know the solution, but it was reassuring to know that there's someone who will listen to me.

dialogue.content: はい、あなたのお力になれればと思っています。親さんを悲しませたくないというあなたの気持ちは尊重します。ですが、親さんもあなたに悲しい思いをさせたくないと思っているのではないかと、私は思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I hope I can be of help to you. I respect your feelings about not wanting to make your parents sad. However, I also think that your parents don't want you to feel sad either.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: 今日ここに相談に来ることも、きっと勇気がいったことと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm sure it must have taken a lot of courage to come and talk here today.

dialogue.content: あなたが、親さんに助けを求める勇気が持てる日がくるよう、ここで話をしに来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please continue to come talk here, so that you can find the courage to ask your parents for help one day.

dialogue.content: はい、また話聞いてください
dialogue.English: Okay, please listen to me again.

dialogue.content: （終了しても大丈夫ですか？）
dialogue.English: (Is it okay to conclude our session?)

dialogue.content: （はい）
dialogue.English: (Yes.)

dialogue.content: 今日はあなたの大切な気持ちを聞かせてくれてありがとうございました。あなたのお力になれればと思います。またご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your important feelings with me today. I hope I can be of help to you. Please feel free to come and talk again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談に来てくれてありがとうございました。それでは、終了メッセージをお送りいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk today. I will now send the closing message.
